summary.text: Jake McCalmon is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 63, part of Williamson County, who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a former small business owner.

paragraphs.text: McCalmon earned a B.S. in business administration from Brandman University, now UMass Global.
The legislature's biography lists him as semi-retired and a former small business owner, and Ballotpedia says he founded and owned Bulldog Martial Arts.
McCalmon has been a member of the House since the 113th General Assembly and serves as vice-chair of the Calendar & Rules Committee.
He is also a member of the Government Operations, State & Local Government and Transportation committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Democrat Laura Andreson in the general election.
